/* 메뉴 */
.mn { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: none; }
.mn.on { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(2,4,7,0.6); }
.mn-box { position: relative; width: 600px; max-height: 660px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,28,34,0.97), rgba(11,16,20,0.97)); border: 1px solid #3a4a52; border-radius: 16px; padding: 4px 8px 2px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
.mn-wide .mn-box { width: 900px; }
.mn h2 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 33px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffe9a8; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000; }
.mn-sub { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #9aa6ab; font-size: 22px; }
.mn-list { overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; padding: 2px; margin-top: 4px; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.mn-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 8px; font: inherit; font-size: 22px; color: #ece6d4; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }

.mn-btn { width: 100%; justify-content: flex-start; }
.mn-btn small { margin-left: auto; color: #7d8a90; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 400; }
.mn-btn em { font-style: normal; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 30px; height: 30px; background: #ece6d4; color: #111; font-size: 22px; flex: none; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
.mn-btn.danger span { color: #ff9a8a; }
.mn-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }
.mn-head { margin: 10px 4px 2px; font-size: 22px; color: #f0b45a; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
.mn-html { font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.4; color: #d8d0bc; padding: 0 6px; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
.mn-html p { margin: 0 0 6px; }
.mn-html table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 22px; }
.mn-html th, .mn-html td { text-align: left; padding: 3px 8px; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.35); font-weight: 400; }
.mn-html th { color: #f0b45a; white-space: nowrap; }
.mn-html kbd { display: inline-block; min-width: 24px; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 5px; background: #ece6d4; color: #111; font: 800 13px/20px inherit; text-align: center; margin: 1px; }
.mn-tog { width: 52px; height: 28px; border-radius: 14px; background: #2c383e; position: relative; flex: none; }
.mn-tog i { position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 3px; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9aa6ab; transition: left 0.12s; }
.mn-tog.on { background: #8a5a1c; }
.mn-tog.on i { left: 27px; background: #ffd890; }
.mn-sl { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.mn-sl b { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #2c383e; font-size: 20px; }
.mn-bar { width: 160px; height: 10px; background: #2c383e; border-radius: 5px; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; }
.mn-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: #f0b45a; }
.mn-sl em { font-style: normal; width: 52px; text-align: right; color: #d8d0bc; font-size: 16px; }
.mn-ch { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.mn-ch b { padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #2c383e; font-size: 15px; }
.mn-ch b.on { background: #8a5a1c; color: #ffe6b8; }
.mn-x { position: absolute; right: 2px; top: 0; width: 48px; height: 48px; border: 0; background: none; color: #ffe27a; font: inherit; font-size: 33px; text-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #000; cursor: pointer; }

/* 타이틀: 로고는 캔버스(title.ts)가 도트로 그리고, 메뉴는 열린 문 안에 오락실 글자로 */
.mn-title.on { background: none; backdrop-filter: none; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; padding-top: 410px; }
.mn-title .mn-box { background: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none; width: 300px; padding: 0; }
.mn-title .mn-logo { display: none; }
.mn-title .mn-list { gap: 2px; overflow: visible; }
.mn-title .mn-row { background: none; min-height: 52px; justify-content: center; font-size: 33px; color: #a89c84; text-shadow: 0 3px 0 #000, 2px 0 0 #000, -2px 0 0 #000, 0 -2px 0 #000; }
.mn-title .gk-btn.f, .mn-title .gk-btn:hover { border-image: none; }
/* 메뉴는 초점(.f) 하나만 강조: 마우스는 pointermove 가 초점을 옮기므로 :hover·:focus 강조는 끈다 */

.mn-title .gk-btn:not(.f):hover { color: #a89c84; }
.mn-title .mn-row span { position: relative; }
.mn-title .mn-row.f { color: #ffe27a; animation: mn-blink 0.9s steps(1) infinite; }
.mn-title .mn-row.f span::before { content: '▶'; position: absolute; right: calc(100% + 14px); color: #ff5a3a; font-size: 22px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
@keyframes mn-blink { 50% { color: #fff6d0; } }

/* 선택지 (대화·승강기) */
.mn-dialog.on { align-items: flex-end; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.7), rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 60%); backdrop-filter: none; padding-bottom: 28px; }
.mn-dialog .mn-box { width: 920px; max-height: 470px; }
.mn-dialog h2 { font-size: 24px; color: #ffd890; }

/* 가로 화면 띠 단추: 도트 금속 칸 + 도트 글꼴, 키 이름 없음 (검수 12) */
.tp-side .tp-b { border-radius: 0; background: none; border-style: solid; border-width: 7px; border-image-width: 7px; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; color: #e8dcb8; }

.tp-side .tp-b b, .tp-side .tp-b.small b, .tp-side .tp-b.top b, .tp-side .tp-b.big b { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; }
.tp-side .tp-b.big b { color: #ffb4a0; }
.tp-side .tp-b.on { background: none; filter: brightness(1.7); }
.tp-side .tp-b.hint { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2c94c, 0 0 12px rgba(242,201,76,0.7); }
.tp-side .tp-b.full { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #f2b632, 0 0 14px rgba(242,182,50,0.9); }
.tp-side .tp-ring { inset: auto 0 -5px 0; height: 4px; border-radius: 0; -webkit-mask: none; mask: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f2b632 calc(var(--g, 0) * 100%), rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0); }
.tp-side .tp-b.item canvas { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
.tp-side .tp-b.item u { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; right: 0; bottom: -4px; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000; }
/* GPT 도트 단추 판 (tools/ui_pixelize.py): 판 그림이 테두리·그림을 다 갖고 있다 */
.tp .tp-b.pl { border: 0; border-image: none; border-radius: 0; background-color: transparent; background-size: contain; background-position: center; background-repeat: no-repeat; image-rendering: pixelated; box-shadow: none; }
.tp .tp-b.pl > b, .tp .tp-b.pl > i { display: none; }
.tp .tp-b.pl.item canvas { width: 64%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1; }
.tp .tp-b.pl.on { background-color: transparent; filter: brightness(1.45); transform-origin: center; }
.tp .tp-b.pl.hint { box-shadow: none; filter: brightness(1.3) drop-shadow(0 0 0 #f2c94c) drop-shadow(0 0 4px #f2c94c); }
.tp .tp-b.pl.full { box-shadow: none; }
.tp .tp-b.pl .tp-ring { display: none; }

.tp .tp-b.pl.item { background-size: 100% 100%; }
.tp .tp-side .tp-b.pl.item u, .tp .tp-b.pl.item u { right: 10px; bottom: 6px; font-size: 18px; }

      const bx = x + fs + 30, bw = s2.compact ? 250 : 300;
      label(c, s2.agent.name, bx, y + 20, 22, C.name, "left", 900);
      c.font = font(22, 900);
      let ax = bx + c.measureText(s2.agent.name).width + 10;
      if (s2.armor) label(c, "◆".repeat(s2.armor), ax, y + 19, 15, C.amber), ax += 50;
      const by = y + 30, bh = 24;
      const r = r0;
      const low2 = r < 0.25;
      c.fillStyle = "#000";
      c.fillRect(bx - 3, by - 3, bw + 6, bh + 6);
      c.fillStyle = "#3a1410";
      c.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
      c.fillStyle = C.trail;
      c.fillRect(bx, by, bw * this.trail / s2.maxHp, bh);
      const hc = low2 ? Math.sin(this.t * 10) > 0 ? C.hpLow : C.hp : r < 0.5 ? C.hpMid : C.hp;
      c.fillStyle = hc;
      c.fillRect(bx, by, bw * r, bh);
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
      c.fillRect(bx, by + 3, bw * r, 4);
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
      c.fillRect(bx, by + bh - 5, bw * r, 5);
      const bf = kitPiece("bar");
      if (bf) nine(c, bf, kitSlice("bar"), bx - 22, by - 10, bw + 44, bh + 20, 2);
      const gy = by + bh + 9, gw = s2.compact ? 180 : 220, gh = 12;
      const full = s2.gauge >= 100;
      c.fillStyle = "#000";
      c.fillRect(bx - 2, gy - 2, gw + 4, gh + 4);
      bar(c, bx, gy, gw, gh, s2.gauge / 100, full ? `hsl(${40 + Math.sin(this.t * 8) * 10},95%,${60 + Math.sin(this.t * 8) * 12}%)` : C.gaugeFill, "#10181c");
      if (full) {
        c.save();
        c.shadowColor = C.gauge;
        c.shadowBlur = 12 + Math.sin(this.t * 8) * 6;
        c.strokeStyle = C.gauge;
        c.lineWidth = 2;
        c.strokeRect(bx - 2, gy - 2, gw + 4, gh + 4);
        c.restore();
        label(c, s2.device === "pad" ? "RT" : s2.device === "touch" ? "필살" : superKey(), bx + gw + 10, gy + 12, 15, C.gauge, "left", 900);
      }
      if (s2.weapon) this.ammo(c, s2.weapon, bx, gy + gh + 30);
      this.meterRows(c, s2, x, y + fs + 52);
    }
    meterRows(c, s2, x, my) {
      for (const m of s2.meters ?? []) {
        label(c, m.label, x, my + 10, 13, m.color, "left", 800);
        bar(c, x + 40, my + 1, 160, 9, m.v / m.max, m.color, "#000");
        my += 18;
      }
      let sx = x;
      for (const st of s2.status ?? []) {
        c.font = font(13, 800);
        const w = c.measureText(st.label).width + 14;
        c.beginPath();
        c.roundRect(sx, my + 4, w, 22, 11);
        c.fillStyle = st.good ? "rgba(60,140,90,0.9)" : "rgba(150,50,50,0.9)";
        c.fill();
        label(c, st.label, sx + 7, my + 20, 13, "#fff", "left", 800);
        sx += w + 6;
      }
    }
    ammo(c, w, x, y) {
      const empty2 = w.mag <= 0;
      bullet(c, x + 6, y - 9, empty2 ? "#7a3a30" : "#f0d890");
      label(c, String(w.mag), x + 20, y, 26, empty2 ? C.hpLow : "#fff", "left", 900);
      c.font = font(26, 900);
      const mw = c.measureText(String(w.mag)).width;
      label(c, `예비 ${w.reserve}`, x + 26 + mw, y, 16, C.dim, "left", 800);
      c.font = font(16, 800);
      const ex = x + 34 + mw + c.measureText(`예비 ${w.reserve}`).width + 8;
      if (w.temp) label(c, `${w.temp.name} ${w.temp.uses}회`, ex, y, 15, C.amber, "left", 800);
      else if (w.reload != null) {
        bar(c, ex, y - 12, 90, 8, w.reload, "#e8e0b0", "#000");
        label(c, "재장전", ex + 98, y, 14, "#e8e0b0", "left", 800);
      } else if (w.mag <= Math.ceil(w.magMax * 0.25)) label(c, w.reserve > 0 ? "재장전!" : "탄 없음", ex, y, 15, Math.sin(this.t * 8) > 0 ? C.hpLow : "#fff", "left", 900);
    }
    /** 층: 오른쪽 위 구석에 글자만 (판 없음). 바뀔 때는 Fx 층 제목이 크게 알린다 */
    floor(c, s2) {
      const f = s2.floor;
      if (s2.field) {
        const r = W2 - (s2.compact ? 100 : 20);
        if (s2.field.clock) label(c, s2.field.clock, r, 34, 26, "#fff", "right", 900);
        if (s2.field.place) label(c, s2.field.place, r, 56, 15, C.amber, "right", 800);
        if (s2.field.wallet) label(c, s2.field.wallet, r, 76, 15, "#cfe3c8", "right", 800);
      }
      if (!f.depth) return;
      const right = W2 - (s2.compact ? 100 : 20);
      label(c, f.depth, right, 44, 32, "#fff", "right", 900);
      if (f.variant) label(c, f.variant, right, 68, 15, C.amber, "right", 800);
    }
    /** 규칙서: 새로 찾은 규칙이 있을 때만 오른쪽 위에 잠깐. 전체 목록은 일시정지 메뉴 */
    rules(c, s2) {
      const fresh = (s2.rules ?? []).filter((r) => r.fresh);
      if (!fresh.length) return;
      let y = s2.floor.variant ? 96 : 76;
      if (s2.boss && s2.compact) y += 34;
      for (const r of fresh.slice(-3)) {
        let t = r.text;
        c.font = font(15, 800);
        while (c.measureText(t).width > 380 && t.length > 4) t = t.slice(0, -2);
        if (t !== r.text) t += "…";
        label(c, `규칙 · ${t}`, W2 - 20, y + 16, 15, Math.sin(this.t * 9) > 0 ? "#fff6a0" : C.rule, "right", 800);
        y += 24;
      }
    }
    /** 아이템: 아이콘만 (글자 없음), 체력 막대 오른쪽 위 천장 띠. 바닥(물건·자막)과 겹치지 않게 (독립 검수: UI 안전영역).
     * 터치 화면에서는 터치 버튼이 대신 보여 준다 */
    /** 아이템 칸 넷 (도트, 필살 게이지 아래). 돌려주는 값 = 아래 끝 y */
    pixelItems(c, items, device, x, y) {
      return drawPixelItems(c, items, x, y, [], this.itemFlash, (it, ix, iy, sz) => drawHudItemIcon(c, it, ix, iy, sz));
    }
    items(c, items, device) {
      const n = 4, s2 = 52, g2 = 8;
      const x0 = 482, y = 22;
      const padKeys = ["↑", "→", "↓", "←"];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const it = items[i] ?? { label: "", count: 0 };
        const x = x0 + i * (s2 + g2);
        const dim2 = it.count <= 0;
        const sf = kitPiece("slot");
        if (sf) nine(c, sf, kitSlice("slot"), x - 4, y - 4, s2 + 8, s2 + 8, 1);
        else {
          c.fillStyle = "#000";
          c.fillRect(x - 2, y - 2, s2 + 4, s2 + 4);
          c.fillStyle = dim2 ? "rgba(30,34,38,0.8)" : "rgba(44,50,56,0.92)";
          c.fillRect(x, y, s2, s2);
        }
        if (this.itemFlash[i] > 0) c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,240,180,${this.itemFlash[i]})`, c.fillRect(x, y, s2, s2);
        if (it.label || it.id) {
          c.save();
          c.globalAlpha = dim2 ? 0.3 : 1;
          drawHudItemIcon(c, it, x + 2, y + 2, s2 - 4);
          c.restore();
        }
        label(c, device === "pad" ? padKeys[i] : String(i + 1), x + 4, y + 14, 12, C.dim, "left", 800);
        if (it.label || it.id) label(c, `${it.count}`, x + s2 - 4, y + s2 - 4, 17, dim2 ? "#6a7276" : "#fff", "right", 900);
        if (it.cd && it.cd > 0) {
          c.save();
          c.beginPath();
          c.moveTo(x + s2 / 2, y + s2 / 2);
          c.arc(x + s2 / 2, y + s2 / 2, s2, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * it.cd);
          c.closePath();
          c.clip();
          c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";
          c.fillRect(x, y, s2, s2);
          c.restore();
        }
      }
    }
    boss(c, b, compact) {
      const w = 640, x = W2 / 2 - w / 2, y = H2 - 128;
      label(c, b.name, x, y - 6, 16, "#f0c0b0");
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.7)";
      c.fillRect(x, y, w, 14);
      c.fillStyle = "#b02a2a";
      c.fillRect(x, y, w * Math.max(0, b.hp) / b.max, 14);
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";
      c.fillRect(x, y, w * Math.max(0, b.hp) / b.max, 4);
      c.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,200,180,0.5)";
      c.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, w - 1, 13);
    }
    timer(c, s2) {
      if (!s2.timer) return;
      const t = Math.max(0, s2.timer.sec);
      const x = s2.compact ? 340 : 482, y = s2.compact ? 174 : 116;
      c.font = font(15);
      const text2 = fitText(c, `${s2.timer.label} ${Math.floor(t / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(t % 60)).padStart(2, "0")}`, s2.compact ? 120 : 230);
      label(c, text2, x, y, 15, t < 10 ? C.hpLow : "#bfe0f0");
    }
    /** 필드 주인공 칸 (전투 HUD가 없는 본부·거점): 왼쪽 아래 도트 얼굴 + 이름 + 체력 + 필살 게이지. 터치·좁은 화면은 왼쪽 위(아래는 스틱 자리).
     * 돌려주는 값 = 칸 오른쪽 끝 x (자막을 그 오른쪽에 둔다) */
    /** 필드(방문) 오른쪽 위: 필드 시각·장소·잔고 (전투 HUD를 안 그리는 필드에서) */
    drawFieldCorner(c, f, compact) {
      if (!f) return;
      c.save();
      const k = compact ? 1.2 : 1;
      W2 = c.canvas.width / k;
      c.setTransform(k, 0, 0, k, 0, 0);
      const r = W2 - (compact ? 100 : 20);
      if (f.clock) label(c, f.clock, r, 34, 26, "#fff", "right", 900);
      if (f.place) label(c, f.place, r, 56, 15, C.amber, "right", 800);
      if (f.wallet) label(c, f.wallet, r, f.clock || f.place ? 76 : 34, 15, "#cfe3c8", "right", 800);
      c.restore();
    }
    drawFieldCard(c, s2, dt = 1 / 60) {
      this.t += dt;
      c.save();
      const k = s2.compact ? 1.2 : 1;
      W2 = c.canvas.width / k;
      H2 = c.canvas.height / k;
      c.setTransform(k, 0, 0, k, 0, 0);
      pixelOn = true;
      const fs = 64, bw = 200, bh = 14;
      const x = 28, y = s2.top ? 28 : H2 - fs - 28;
      if (this.lastHp >= 0 && s2.hp < this.lastHp) this.hurtT = 0.35, this.trailHold = 0.5;
      if (this.trail < 0 || this.trail < s2.hp) this.trail = s2.hp;
      else if (this.trailHold > 0) this.trailHold -= dt;
      else this.trail = Math.max(s2.hp, this.trail - s2.maxHp * dt * 0.6);
      this.lastHp = s2.hp;
      this.hurtT = Math.max(0, this.hurtT - dt);
      if (pixelHudReady()) {
        const cy = s2.top ? 14 : H2 - 170;
        const end = drawPixelCard(c, { name: s2.name, face: s2.face, hp: s2.hp, maxHp: s2.maxHp, trail: this.trail, hurtT: this.hurtT, gauge: s2.gauge, superKey: superKey(), t: this.t }, 16, cy);
        if (s2.items && !s2.compact) this.pixelItems(c, s2.items, s2.device, 16 + 84, end + 6);
        pixelOn = false;
        c.restore();
        return (16 + 340) * k;
      }
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(6,10,14,0.72)";
      c.fillRect(x - 12, y - 12, fs + bw + 52, fs + 24);
      c.fillStyle = "#141b20";
      c.fillRect(x, y, fs, fs);
      c.save();
      c.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      if (s2.face) c.drawImage(s2.face, x, y, fs, fs);
      else label(c, s2.name.slice(0, 1) || "?", x + fs / 2, y + fs * 0.7, 34, "#fff", "center", 900);
      c.restore();
      if (this.hurtT > 0) c.fillStyle = `rgba(255,40,40,${this.hurtT * 1.2})`, c.fillRect(x, y, fs, fs);
      const pf = kitPiece("portrait");
      if (pf) nine(c, pf, kitSlice("portrait"), x - 8, y - 8, fs + 16, fs + 16, 1);
      else c.strokeStyle = C.frame, c.lineWidth = 3, c.strokeRect(x - 1.5, y - 1.5, fs + 3, fs + 3);
      const bx = x + fs + 18;
      label(c, s2.name, bx, y + 16, 18, C.name, "left", 900);
      if (s2.sub) {
        c.font = font(18, 900);
        label(c, s2.sub, bx + c.measureText(s2.name).width + 10, y + 16, 13, C.amber, "left", 800);
      }
      const by = y + 26;
      const r = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, s2.hp / s2.maxHp));
      c.fillStyle = "#000";
      c.fillRect(bx - 2, by - 2, bw + 4, bh + 4);
      c.fillStyle = "#3a1410";
      c.fillRect(bx, by, bw, bh);
      c.fillStyle = C.trail;
      c.fillRect(bx, by, bw * this.trail / s2.maxHp, bh);
      c.fillStyle = r < 0.25 ? Math.sin(this.t * 10) > 0 ? C.hpLow : C.hp : r < 0.5 ? C.hpMid : C.hp;
      c.fillRect(bx, by, Math.round(bw * r), bh);
      c.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
      c.fillRect(bx, by + 2, Math.round(bw * r), 2);
      const bf = kitPiece("bar");
      if (bf) nine(c, bf, kitSlice("bar"), bx - 14, by - 7, bw + 28, bh + 14, 1);
      label(c, `${Math.max(0, Math.ceil(s2.hp))}`, bx + bw - 4, by + bh - 2, 12, "#fff", "right", 900);
      if (s2.gauge !== void 0) {
        const gy = by + bh + 8, gw = 150, gh = 8, full = s2.gauge >= 100;
        c.fillStyle = "#000";
        c.fillRect(bx - 2, gy - 2, gw + 4, gh + 4);
        bar(c, bx, gy, gw, gh, s2.gauge / 100, full ? `hsl(${40 + Math.sin(this.t * 8) * 10},95%,${60 + Math.sin(this.t * 8) * 12}%)` : C.gaugeFill, "#10181c");
        if (full) label(c, `필살 ${superKey()}`, bx + gw + 8, gy + 9, 12, C.gauge, "left", 900);
      }
      pixelOn = false;
      c.restore();
      return (x + fs + bw + 40) * k;
    }
    /** 말풍선 (본부 대사): x = 말하는 사람 가운데, y = 머리 위(풍선 꼬리 끝), 캔버스 px. who가 있으면 위에 이름 */
    drawSpeech(c, p) {
      c.save();
      const k = p.compact ? 1.2 : 1;
      c.setTransform(k, 0, 0, k, 0, 0);
      W2 = c.canvas.width / k;
      pixelOn = true;
      const U2 = 2;
      c.font = font(22);
      const lines3 = wrapText(c, p.text, 400, 3);
      const tw = Math.max(...lines3.map((l) => Math.ceil(c.measureText(l).width)), p.who ? Math.ceil(c.measureText(p.who).width) * 0.55 : 0);
      const nameH = p.who ? 18 : 0, lh = 26, padX = 12, padY = 8;
      const w = tw + padX * 2, h = nameH + lines3.length * lh + padY * 2 - 4;
      const tail = 10;
      let x = Math.round(p.x / k - w / 2);
      x = Math.max(8, Math.min(W2 - w - 8, x));
      const y = Math.round(Math.max(8, p.y / k - tail - h));
      const box2 = (bx, by, bw, bh, col) => {
        c.fillStyle = col;
        c.fillRect(bx + U2, by, bw - 2 * U2, bh);
        c.fillRect(bx, by + U2, bw, bh - 2 * U2);
      };
      box2(x + U2, y + U2 * 2, w, h, "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)");
      box2(x - U2, y - U2, w + 2 * U2, h + 2 * U2, "#0b0f12");
      box2(x, y, w, h, "#cfc8b4");
      box2(x + U2, y + U2, w - 2 * U2, h - 2 * U2, "#1a2026");
      const tx = Math.round(Math.max(x + 10, Math.min(x + w - 18, p.x / k - 4)));
      for (let i = 0; i < tail / U2; i++) {
        const tw2 = Math.max(U2, 10 - i * U2 * 2);
        c.fillStyle = "#0b0f12";
        c.fillRect(tx + (10 - tw2) / 2 - U2, y + h + i * U2 - U2, tw2 + 2 * U2, U2 + U2);
        c.fillStyle = "#cfc8b4";
        c.fillRect(tx + (10 - tw2) / 2, y + h + i * U2 - U2, tw2, U2);
      }
      c.textAlign = "left";
      c.textBaseline = "middle";
      let ty = y + padY + 2;
      if (p.who) {
        c.font = font(11);
        c.fillStyle = "#ffcf6a";
        c.fillText(p.who, x + padX, ty + 6);
        ty += nameH;
      }
      c.font = font(22);
      c.fillStyle = "#f2ecdc";
      lines3.forEach((l, i) => c.fillText(l, x + padX, ty + lh / 2 + i * lh - 2));
      pixelOn = false;
      c.restore();
    }
    /** 상호작용 안내: 캐릭터 옆에 뜨는 도트 말풍선 (키 단추 + 짧은 말). x,y = 캐릭터 머리 옆 화면 px(캔버스 px), side = 말풍선이 뻗는 쪽 */
    drawPrompt(c, p) {
      c.save();
      const k = p.compact ? 1.2 : 1;
      c.setTransform(k, 0, 0, k, 0, 0);
      pixelOn = true;
      const U2 = 2;
      c.font = font(22);
      const tw = Math.ceil(c.measureText(p.text).width);
      const cap = 30, gap = 8, padX = 10, h = 40;
      const w = padX + cap + gap + tw + padX + (p.locked ? 20 : 0);
      const bob = Math.round(Math.sin(performance.now() / 260) * 2);
      let x = Math.round(p.x / k + (p.side > 0 ? 0 : -w)), y = Math.round(p.y / k - h / 2 + bob);
      const box2 = (bx, by, bw, bh, col) => {
        c.fillStyle = col;
        c.fillRect(bx + U2, by, bw - 2 * U2, bh);
        c.fillRect(bx, by + U2, bw, bh - 2 * U2);
      };
      box2(x + U2, y + U2 * 2, w, h, "rgba(0,0,0,0.35)");
      box2(x - U2, y - U2, w + 2 * U2, h + 2 * U2, "#0b0f12");
      box2(x, y, w, h, p.locked ? "#c98a1c" : "#cfc8b4");
      box2(x + U2, y + U2, w - 2 * U2, h - 2 * U2, "#1a2026");
      const tx = p.side > 0 ? x - U2 * 3 : x + w + U2;
      c.fillStyle = p.locked ? "#c98a1c" : "#cfc8b4";
      c.fillRect(tx, y + h / 2 - U2, U2 * 2, U2 * 2);
      c.fillRect(p.side > 0 ? tx + U2 * 2 : tx - U2, y + h / 2 - U2 * 2, U2, U2 * 4);
      const kx = x + padX, ky = y + (h - cap) / 2;
      box2(kx, ky + U2, cap, cap, "#6e6656");
      box2(kx, ky, cap, cap - U2, p.locked ? "#5a4a2a" : "#f2ead6");
      c.font = font(22);
      c.fillStyle = p.locked ? "#c9b48a" : "#1a2026";
      c.textAlign = "center";
      c.textBaseline = "middle";
      c.fillText(p.key, kx + cap / 2, ky + cap / 2);
      let txx = kx + cap + gap;
      if (p.locked) {
        c.fillStyle = "#ffcf6a";
        c.fillRect(txx + 2, y + 18, 12, 10);
        c.fillRect(txx + 4, y + 12, 2, 6);
        c.fillRect(txx + 10, y + 12, 2, 6);
        c.fillRect(txx + 4, y + 11, 8, 2);
        c.fillStyle = "#1a2026";
        c.fillRect(txx + 7, y + 21, 2, 4);
        txx += 20;
      }
      c.textAlign = "left";
      c.fillStyle = p.locked ? "#ffcf6a" : "#f2ecdc";
      c.fillText(p.text, txx, y + h / 2 + 1);
      pixelOn = false;
      c.restore();
    }
    /** 왼쪽 아래 기술 칸 줄 (도트, PixelLab 틀). 돌려주는 값 = 오른쪽 끝 x (캔버스 px) */
    drawSkillBox(c, s2, dt = 1 / 60) {
      this.t += dt;
      if (!pixelHudReady()) return 0;
      c.save();
      const k = s2.compact ? 1.2 : 1;
      W2 = c.canvas.width / k;
      H2 = c.canvas.height / k;
      c.setTransform(k, 0, 0, k, 0, 0);
      const sz = hotbarSize(s2.slots.length);
      const end = drawPixelHotbar(c, s2.slots, 16, H2 - sz.h - 10, this.t);
